experiment: Empty-venv installation self-check for the realtime Python environment
purpose: Verify the README's realtime environment steps from an empty venv: create the venv, install the pinned CUDA wheels and requirements-realtime.txt, run pip check, import the realtime modules, check CUDA availability, and decode a generated 1-second WAV with TorchCodec AudioDecoder. Environment only; no model weights, no training data, no model service.

environment.venv_naming: venv-realtime-<run-id> under the run data directory; empty-venv policy enforced by the script

interpretation: This run verified the script's empty-venv creation, pinned install order, fail-fast behavior and machine-readable summary, and documented a concrete blocker: on this device the pip proxy refuses connections to the PyTorch wheel index. Per the run contract the failure stopped the run immediately with no version change, repair attempt or retry.
